info.name: Mekoya API
info.description:
Government service guide and appointment platform.

1. Start the API (npm run dev).
2. Set the adminPassword variable to SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD from your .env.
3. Run the "Scenarios" folder in order (Collection Runner, or Newman).

Generated by scripts/generate-postman.ts from the OpenAPI document.

item.name: Reference: every endpoint
item.description: One request per documented endpoint, generated from the OpenAPI document, so it always matches the API. Run the Setup folder first so the tokens exist.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness check

request.description:
Check that the API and database are up

**Public.** No token needed.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, Google sign-in, token refresh, email verification, password reset and staff invitations

request.description:
Register a citizen account

**Public.** No token needed.

Always creates a `CITIZEN`: a role in the request body is ignored. Passwords need 8 to 72 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol, and are stored as bcrypt hashes (cost 12). A verification email is sent in the background, and a failure to send it never fails the registration.

Log in with email and password

**Public.** No token needed.

Returns a short-lived access token (15 minutes) in the body and sets the refresh token as an httpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`. The same generic 401 is returned for a wrong password, an unknown email and a Google-only account, so account existence is not revealed. Citizens can log in before verifying their email, but cannot book until they do.

Log in or register with a Google ID token

**Public.** No token needed.

Verifies the Google ID token (signature, expiry, audience and verified email). Existing accounts are **linked** by email, and unknown emails get a new citizen account with no password. If the existing account was never email-verified, linking clears its password and revokes its sessions, which stops pre-registration takeover. Returns 503 `GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED` when the server has no Google client id.

Get a new access token (refresh token rotation)

**Public.** No token needed.

Reads the refresh token from the httpOnly cookie, so there is no request body. Every refresh token works **once**: it is replaced by a new one in the same family. Presenting an already-used token is treated as theft, so the **whole family is revoked** and an audit entry is written. In Swagger UI the browser sends the cookie automatically after you log in here.

Log out of this session

**Public.** No token needed.

Revokes the refresh token family of the cookie and clears the cookie. Always succeeds, even if the cookie is missing or unknown. An access token already issued stays valid until it expires (up to 15 minutes).

Log out of every device

**Requires** a valid access token.

Show who the access token belongs to

**Requires** a valid access token.

Returns the claims inside the access token, including permissions. Permission changes reach a token the next time it is refreshed.

Verify an email address with the emailed token

**Public.** No token needed.

The token is single use and expires after 24 hours. It is a POST on purpose: email security scanners open every link in a message, and a GET link would verify on their request.

Send a new verification email

**Requires** a valid access token.

Request a password reset email

**Public.** No token needed.

Always answers the same way, whether or not the email is registered, so registered emails cannot be discovered. The reset link lasts 30 minutes.

Set a new password with the emailed token

**Public.** No token needed.

Single use. Revokes every existing session of the account.

Activate a staff account from an invitation

**Public.** No token needed.

Staff accounts are created by the Super Admin without a password. The invited person sets it here with the token from the invitation email (valid for 72 hours, single use).

item.name: Catalog
item.description: Public browsing of services, requirements and offices

request.description:
Search and browse services

**Public.** No token needed.

Only active services are listed. Names and descriptions follow `Accept-Language` (`am` or `en`), falling back to English field by field.

Get a service with its document checklist and offices

**Public.** No token needed.

Each requirement `id` is the **checklist item id** that uploads attach to.

List offices, optionally by city or the service they offer

**Public.** No token needed.

item.name: Appointments
item.description: Slots, booking, cancelling and rescheduling

request.description:
See free time slots at an office for a service and date

**Public.** No token needed.

Times are Addis Ababa time (UTC+3). Offices are closed on weekends. The result is a snapshot: a slot shown as free can be taken a moment later, and booking re-checks capacity.

Book an appointment

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:book` permission.

Requires a **verified email** (`403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`). Capacity is enforced under a database lock, so simultaneous bookings can never exceed the slot capacity (`409 SLOT_FULL`). Other rules: a citizen can hold at most 2 active appointments per service (`LIMIT_REACHED`), cannot hold two at the same time (`TIME_CONFLICT`), and must book 60 minutes to 60 days ahead (`SLOT_TOO_SOON`, `SLOT_TOO_FAR`, `OFFICE_CLOSED` on weekends).

Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe: repeating the same key returns the **same appointment** with status 200 and an `Idempotent-Replay: true` header instead of booking twice.

List my appointments

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:view-own` permission.

Get one of my appointments with its checklist and document status

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:view-own` permission.

**Ownership check (ABAC):** only the owner, or a Super Admin, may read it. Anyone else gets 403.

Cancel an appointment

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:book` permission.

Owner only. Allowed until 12 hours before the slot (`409 TOO_LATE`), and only while the appointment is active (`409 INVALID_STATE`).

Move an appointment to another slot or office

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:book` permission.

Owner only, with the same rules and cutoff as booking and cancelling. Uploaded documents stay attached. The reminder email is re-armed for the new time.

item.name: Documents
item.description: Uploads, downloads and appeals. Automatic review runs in the background

request.description:
Upload a document for a checklist item

**Requires** a valid access token with the `document:upload` permission.

Multipart form with the `file` and the `serviceRequirementId` (the checklist item id from the appointment). JPEG, PNG or PDF up to **5 MB**. The type is verified by reading the file's first bytes, not only the declared type. Files are stored under a random name.

Uploading again for the same item creates a **new version** and keeps the old one as history. An approved document cannot be replaced. The response returns immediately and an **automatic review runs in the background**: poll the appointment to see `AI_APPROVED`, `AI_REJECTED` or `NEEDS_HUMAN`. When every mandatory document is approved, the appointment becomes `CONFIRMED` automatically.

Download a document

**Requires** a valid access token.

Allowed for the owning citizen (and Super Admin), and for an officer with `document:review` **whose office matches the appointment**. Always served as an attachment.

Ask an officer to review a document the automatic check rejected

**Requires** a valid access token with the `document:upload` permission.

Owner only, and only for documents with status `AI_REJECTED`. The document moves to the officers' `NEEDS_HUMAN` queue.

item.name: AI
item.description: Smart checklist: describe a situation, get the right service and documents

request.description:
Find the right service and document checklist from a free-text description

**Requires** a valid access token with the `ai:use` permission.

The citizen describes their situation, and the AI model **picks a service from the real catalog**. The document list is always read from the database, never written by the model, and an invented service id is discarded. If the model is unsure the response is `NO_CONFIDENT_MATCH` with candidates and a clarifying question. If the AI is down or slow, a keyword matcher answers instead (`provider: keyword`, `aiStatus: FALLBACK`) so the endpoint never fails because of the AI, and after a failure the AI is skipped for 60 seconds.

`situationNotes` is AI-generated advice, **not official guidance**. Do not include ID numbers or other personal details in the description. The text is sent to the AI provider. Limited to 10 requests per minute per user in production.

item.name: Officer
item.description: The office queue, completing visits, and reviewing documents that need a human

request.description:
Today's queue for my office

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:view-office` permission.

**Office scope (ABAC):** the office comes from the officer's own account, and there is no way to ask for another office. Defaults to today (Addis Ababa time).

Open an appointment in my office, with the citizen and AI details

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:view-office` permission.

**Office scope (ABAC):** an officer of another office gets 403.

Complete a confirmed appointment

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:complete` permission.

Only `CONFIRMED` appointments (all mandatory documents approved) in the officer's own office. Allowed from 30 minutes before the slot.

Mark an appointment as a no-show

**Requires** a valid access token with the `appointment:complete` permission.

Only after the slot time has passed, from `BOOKED` or `CONFIRMED`, in the officer's own office.

Documents waiting for a human decision in my office

**Requires** a valid access token with the `document:review` permission.

Defaults to `NEEDS_HUMAN` (low AI confidence, AI failure, or a citizen appeal). Each item includes the AI observation so the officer sees what the model reported.

Approve, reject or override a document decision

**Requires** a valid access token with the `document:review` permission.

Works on any **current** document in the officer's own office while the appointment is open, including overriding an AI decision in either direction. A rejection needs a `reason`, which is emailed to the citizen. The audit log records the previous status, so an override is visible. The appointment is confirmed or un-confirmed automatically to match.

item.name: Admin: catalog
item.description: Content admin: services, requirements, offices and their links

request.description:
Create a service

**Requires** a valid access token with the `service:manage` permission.

Update a service (send only the fields to change)

**Requires** a valid access token with the `service:manage` permission.

Set `isActive: true` to bring back a deactivated service.

Deactivate a service (soft delete)

**Requires** a valid access token with the `service:manage` permission.

Nothing is deleted: the service disappears from public listings, and existing appointments stay valid.

Attach a requirement to a service, or change its mandatory flag and notes

**Requires** a valid access token with the `service:manage` permission.

Idempotent: calling it again sets the same state.

Remove a requirement from a service

**Requires** a valid access token with the `service:manage` permission.

Fails with 409 if citizens already uploaded documents against it. Deactivate the requirement instead.

Create a requirement (a kind of document)

**Requires** a valid access token with the `requirement:manage` permission.

`expectedType` is the code the AI review checks against, for example `PASSPORT_PHOTO`.

Update a requirement

**Requires** a valid access token with the `requirement:manage` permission.

Deactivate a requirement (soft delete)

**Requires** a valid access token with the `requirement:manage` permission.

Create an office

**Requires** a valid access token with the `office:manage` permission.

`slotTimes` are daily appointment start times in Addis Ababa time, in `HH:mm`.

Update an office

**Requires** a valid access token with the `office:manage` permission.

Deactivate an office (soft delete)

**Requires** a valid access token with the `office:manage` permission.

Offer a service at an office, with its seats per time slot

**Requires** a valid access token with the `office:manage` permission.

Stop offering a service at an office

**Requires** a valid access token with the `office:manage` permission.

item.name: Admin: users
item.description: Super Admin: staff invitations, user status and the audit log

request.description:
Invite a staff member (officer or content admin)

**Requires** a valid access token with the `user:manage` permission.

Creates the account **without a password** and emails an invitation (valid 72 hours). An officer must be assigned to an active office. A `SUPER_ADMIN` cannot be created through the API.

List users

**Requires** a valid access token with the `user:manage` permission.

`status` is `INVITED` (no way to log in yet), `ACTIVE` or `DEACTIVATED`.

Deactivate or reactivate a user

**Requires** a valid access token with the `user:manage` permission.

Deactivating revokes every refresh token. You cannot change your own status or a Super Admin.

Resend a staff invitation

**Requires** a valid access token with the `user:manage` permission.

Only for accounts that have not been activated. The previous link stops working.

Read the audit log

**Requires** a valid access token with the `audit:read` permission.

Append-only. Entries with no actor are system actions (automatic review, auto-confirm).
